name: Qualitative or Quantitative Defects of FKRP

criteria.description: Identification of pathogenic variants in the FKRP gene by molecular genetic testing
Muscle biopsy showing reduced or abnormal glycosylation of alpha-dystroglycan
Presence of progressive muscular weakness predominantly affecting proximal muscles
MRI evidence of structural brain abnormalities such as cobblestone lissencephaly or white matter changes
Evidence of cardiomyopathy on echocardiogram or cardiac MRI

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Pathogenic FKRP gene variants plus either muscle biopsy evidence of abnormal alpha-dystroglycan glycosylation or characteristic clinical features of muscular dystrophy
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis may be supported by brain imaging and cardiac evaluation findings.

pathognomonic.notes: Detected via immunohistochemistry or western blot on muscle biopsy
searchTerms: defective sugar modification of muscle protein
abnormal sugar attachment on muscle protein

pathognomonic.symptomName: Proximal muscle weakness with limb-girdle distribution
searchTerms: weakness in muscles around hips and shoulders

common.symptomName: Cardiomyopathy including dilated or hypertrophic forms
searchTerms: heart muscle disease with enlargement or thickening

common.symptomName: Mild cognitive impairment or developmental delay
searchTerms: developmental delay or mild intellectual impairment

common.symptomName: Respiratory muscle weakness leading to restrictive lung disease
searchTerms: breathing difficulty from weak chest muscles

occasional.symptomName: Structural brain abnormalities on MRI (e.g., cobblestone lissencephaly)
searchTerms: abnormal brain development seen on imaging

occasional.symptomName: Ophthalmological abnormalities including myopia and retinal changes
searchTerms: eye problems including nearsightedness and retina changes

laboratory: Hypoglycosylation of alpha-dystroglycan on muscle biopsy
imaging: Brain MRI showing cobblestone lissencephaly or white matter abnormalities
Cardiac MRI or echocardiogram demonstrating cardiomyopathy
genetic: Pathogenic variants in FKRP gene confirmed by molecular genetic testing
other: Muscle biopsy showing dystrophic changes and reduced alpha-dystroglycan glycosylation

distinguishingFeatures: Mutations in FKRP but with milder phenotype
Severe congenital muscular dystrophy with brain malformations

redFlags: Rapidly progressive proximal muscle weakness in childhood
Evidence of brain malformations on neuroimaging
references: Mercuri E, et al. FKRP-related muscular dystrophies: clinical and molecular spectrum. Neurology. 2019.
Orphanet: Qualitative or quantitative defects of FKRP. Orphanet Report Series. 2023.
Godfrey C, et al. Dystroglycanopathies: clinical and genetic spectrum. Neuromuscul Disord. 2011.
